title: Data Cleaning Hero
blurb: The AI lab's data is a mess. Fix it, retrain, and watch a junk model turn into a smart one.
objectives: Why messy data wrecks an AI
How to spot and fix bad data
Why clean data can beat a fancier model

glossary.def: A blank where a number should be — the AI doesn't know what goes there.
A value that's way off, like an age of 500. Usually a mistake.
The same record copied twice — it double-counts and skews things.
If you train on bad data, you get a bad model — no matter how clever it is.

steps.title: The lab is failing
steps.body:
Alarm bells! The lab's AI keeps making terrible guesses, and the scientists are stumped.

You take one look at the training data and spot the problem instantly: it's a **mess**. Ages like `500`, blanks, `???`, and rows copied twice. Your mission: clean it up.

steps.title: Will cleaning help?
steps.prompt: If you fix the messy data and train the *exact same* model, what happens to its accuracy?
steps.afterPick: Hold that thought — you're about to see the difference with your own eyes. →

steps.title: Clean the data, then train
steps.youWillDo: fix every flagged row, then train
steps.body: Each **flagged** row is broken in some way. For each one, choose to **Remove** it or **Estimate** a sensible value. When the table is clean, press **Train model** and compare the two scores.

steps.title: Same model, way smarter
steps.body:
Look at that gap. The **algorithm never changed** — only the data did. Clean data took the model from clueless to sharp.

That's the rule pros live by: **garbage in, garbage out.** A simple model on clean data usually beats a fancy model on junk.

steps.title: Why did it matter?
steps.question: An age value of `500` showed up in the data. Why is that a problem for training?
choices: It's impossible, so it teaches the model a wrong pattern
It isn't a problem at all
steps.explain: The model treats every example as truth. Feed it impossible values and it learns impossible patterns.

steps.title: Say it your way
steps.prompt: Explain to a friend why cleaning data made the AI better, even though the model stayed the same.

recall.question: The cleaned model scored higher mainly because of…
recall.explain: Better data, same model. Data quality is doing the heavy lifting.

steps.title: The unglamorous superpower 🎉
steps.body:
You just did the job real data scientists spend **most of their time** on: cleaning data.

It's not flashy, but it's one of the highest-impact things in all of AI. Missing values, outliers, duplicates — hunt them down and your models get better for free. **Next up:** build a clear prompt that gets an AI to do exactly what you want.
